[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You say the Consort of Shadow's child[XENO:n ]
survived her ordeal?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I, Talco, vow to see your orders fulfilled.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Whilst she is in the capital? Do not underestimate the lengths[XENO:n ]
to which His Majesty and the child's loathsome goons will go.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
How, pray tell, will you avoid the guards?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
I will do whatever it takes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Oh, your stupidity bores me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Enough of your drivel.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

We will have our chance. Once she[XENO:n ]
stakes her claim to the throne.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
